DL.name: Delhi domestic (DERC)
DL.formula: FPPAS on energy charge; 8% surcharge and 7% pension surcharge on energy + fixed; 5% tax on energy + FPPAS + 8% surcharge. As printed on a BRPL bill for June-July 2026.
estimates: fppas_pct changes monthly by DERC order; these are June 2026. The bill-amount calibration absorbs later changes
subsidy: modelled on net billed units for solar homes, applied to the whole bill
export_rate_rs_per_kwh: year-end payout for surplus units, placeholder until checked against DERC net-metering rules
sources: BRPL domestic bill, billing period 09-06-2026 to 06-07-2026 (FPPAS 17.94%, formula and slabs as printed)
